# `approx_top_k_accumulate`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Accumulates items into a sketch.
`maxItemsTracked` An optional positive INTEGER literal with upper limit of 1000000. If maxItemsTracked is not specified, it defaults to 10000.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.1 and later.

## Syntax

```text
approx_top_k_accumulate(expr, maxItemsTracked)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- approx_top_k_accumulate, example 1
> SELECT approx_top_k_estimate(approx_top_k_accumulate(expr)) FROM VALUES (0), (0), (1), (1), (2), (3), (4), (4) AS tab(expr);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

```sql
-- approx_top_k_accumulate, example 2
> SELECT approx_top_k_estimate(approx_top_k_accumulate(expr, 100), 2) FROM VALUES 'a', 'b', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'd', 'd' AS tab(expr);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.1.0.
